Bernoulli.title: Fed cuts rates at the next FOMC? ({stamp})
Bernoulli.event: Binary: does the FOMC announce a cut in the target range at the next scheduled meeting?
Bernoulli.description: YES if the FOMC statement lowers the federal funds target range versus the prior meeting; NO otherwise (hold or hike). Cover and listing stay on Fed / rate-decision day. Early occurrence is off for the happy-path video (use Halt/VOID branch fixtures separately). Committee submits YES/NO with off-chain evidence (statement URL + hash).
